segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: So how have you been feeling since your last visit?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Doctor I have been having some fatigue and my feet swell up a little in the evening. No chest pain though.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Okay, any changes in your urination or excessive thirst?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: A little more thirsty than usual, yes.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: Your sugar seems to be running high, HbA1c was eight point two last time. Let's continue Metformin five hundred milligrams twice a day and add Atorvastatin ten milligrams at night for your cholesterol.

segments.speaker: doctor
segments.text: I want to rule out early kidney involvement given the swelling, so let's get a repeat HbA1c and a kidney function test.
